svg.aria-label: Elastic SIEM lab architecture: Windows 10 and Windows Server 2016 with Sysmon and Winlogbeat, and a FortiGate firewall over syslog, feeding Logstash and Fleet Server into Elasticsearch and Kibana on Ubuntu. A Kali attack simulation is in an isolated lab. Team of five, led by Antonyos.
